hebrewText: שְׁמֹ֣ר מִצְוֺתַ֣/י וֶ/חְיֵ֑ה וְ֝/תוֹרָתִ֗/י כְּ/אִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֶֽי/ךָ

tokens.bdb: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
tokens.kjv: beward, be circumspect, take heed (to self), keep(-er, self), mark, look narrowly, observe, preserve, regard, reserve, save (self), sure, (that lay) wait (for), watch(-man).

tokens.bdb: a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law)
to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
tokens.kjv: keep (leave, make) alive, [idiom] certainly, give (promise) life, (let, suffer to) live, nourish up, preserve (alive), quicken, recover, repair, restore (to life), revive, ([idiom] God) save (alive, life, lives), [idiom] surely, be whole.

tokens.bdb: a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch
the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence, the middle (of night)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence
tokens.enLiteralWord: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence
tokens.explanation: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence
tokens.explanationEn: the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence

tokens.bdb: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
tokens.kjv: affliction, outward appearance, [phrase] before, [phrase] think best, colour, conceit, [phrase] be content, countenance, [phrase] displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, [phrase] favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), [idiom] him, [phrase] humble, knowledge, look, ([phrase] well), [idiom] me, open(-ly), [phrase] (not) please, presence, [phrase] regard, resemblance, sight, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them, [phrase] think, [idiom] us, well, [idiom] you(-rselves).
